title: It's okay to say no (teacup reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
You're allowed to say no. ☕

You can protect your time, even with family.
A no to one more favour can be a yes to your own rest.
Try it once this week: "I can't this time." Then stop. No long reasons.

Send this to someone who can't say no.

#boundaries #sayno #selfrespect #emotionalwellness #soundmind
